name: Atari 8-bit computers (400/800, 600XL/800XL, 65XE/130XE, XEGS)

variants.name: Atari 400/800
variants.os: 10 KB OS ROM (rev A/B), BASIC on a cartridge
variants.notes: memory map below is the XL/XE one; on 400/800 there is no PORTB banking and the OS ROM is D800-FFFF (floating point D800-DFFF, charset E000-E3FF) with C000-CFFF unused

variants.name: 600XL/800XL/1200XL
variants.os: 16 KB OS ROM, BASIC built in (switchable)

variants.name: 65XE/130XE/XEGS
variants.os: 16 KB OS ROM, BASIC built in (switchable)
variants.notes: 130XE adds 64 KB of banked RAM through PORTB bits 2-3 (window 4000-7FFF)

cpu.notes: ANTIC steals cycles (WSYNC, DMA); a cycle-exact core must model that. Clock is the nominal NTSC colour-clock / 2; PAL value is the PAL equivalent.

regions.name: RAM (user, 40 KB)
regions.notes: page 0-1 CPU, 2-3 OS, screen and display list wherever the program places them

regions.name: BASIC ROM / cartridge right slot
regions.notes: A000-BFFF: built-in BASIC (XL/XE, PORTB bit 1 = 0) or the right-slot cartridge

regions.name: PIA
regions.notes: D300-D3FF, PORTA/PORTB/PACTL/PBCTL; PORTB also drives banking on XL/XE

regions.name: Cartridge control
regions.notes: D500-D7FF, bank-select areas for banked cartridges

regions.name: OS ROM (high part)
regions.notes: D800-FFFF: floating point D800-DFFF, internal character set E000-E3FF, OS code and vectors up to FFFF

regions.name: Self-test ROM window
regions.notes: 5000-57FF, XL/XE, PORTB bit 7 = 0 with the OS enabled

regions.name: Extended RAM window
regions.notes: 4000-7FFF, 130XE and expansions: PORTB bits 2-3 pick one of four 16 KB banks, bit 4 enables CPU access, bit 5 enables ANTIC access; larger expansions (Rambo, Compy-Shop) use more bits

regions.name: Left cartridge
regions.notes: 8000-9FFF with a 16 KB or left-slot cartridge (400/800 and 5200-style layouts)

native.note: normal-width playfield, 8 pixel tall characters; narrow 256 and wide 384 playfields exist

overscan.note: buffer size used by this repo's emulator (emu.js: 384x240, 336 columns shown); not a hardware limit

modes.name: GRAPHICS 8 (ANTIC F)
modes.notes: one hue, two luminances; artifacting on NTSC gives colour

palette.note: colour register = 4-bit hue and 3-bit luminance (bit 0 unused); hue 0 is grey. Hue angles differ between NTSC and PAL.

video.sprites: 4 players (8 px wide) and 4 missiles, positioned horizontally by registers, vertically by data (DMA)

audio.notes: four 8-bit channels (or two 16-bit pairs), polynomial-counter noise and distortion, high-pass filter; two POKEYs (stereo) are a common upgrade

rom.note: E000-E3FF; display (internal) codes differ from ATASCII codes: bits 5-6 of the code are rotated

controllers.notes: 4 ports on 400/800, 2 on XL/XE; one fire button; paddles and light pen share the ports

media.notes: 810/1050 drives: 40 tracks, 18 sectors (single, 128 B) or 26 (enhanced); double density 256 B; the first three sectors are always 128 bytes
CAR has a 16-byte header with a type code; raw ROMs need the type given by the user
FSK blocks of 132 bytes via the 410/1010 recorder

roms.note: ROM images are never committed or embedded; the user points the app at a local folder. Hashes are recorded locally by the ROM scan.

testMaterial: archive/blank/*.atr (blank disks generated by this repo)
Altirra replacement OS/BASIC ROMs as tracked under roms/altirra/ (licence to be confirmed per file before redistribution)
